name: Release Control
description: Release board for the orca-release skills: every project lit by its release state, opened from any project, with one button to pull, fetch, push, open a PR, deploy or start dev in the right workspace — terminals where no judgement is needed, agents where it is.

settings.title: Agent to launch
settings.description: The agent that starts when you press a button such as Push or Deploy.

settings.title: Refresh every (minutes)
settings.description: How often to re-read the project state. It also refreshes when an agent finishes or a worktree is created.

settings.title: Fetch every (minutes)
settings.description: Runs git fetch in every project in the background so “to pull” stays current. 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Notify when an agent needs me
settings.description: A desktop notification when an agent in one of the projects stops to wait for an answer.

settings.title: Notify when a push or deploy lands
settings.description: A desktop notification when a push or deploy started from the board shows up in the data.

settings.title: Gitea: use git credentials
settings.description: Read open PRs and CI from Gitea servers with the credentials git already stores for them (never prompts). Off: Gitea PRs are not shown.

settings.title: Check environments
settings.description: On each refresh, call the url of every deploy target that has one (`- url:` in the recipe) to show up/down, the deployed version and how far behind it is.
